biggest_catch: Very long Election Day (15 hours, 5:45 a.m.-9:00 p.m.); training and setup pay only for judges who serve.
catches: Election Day is a 15-hour day (5:45 a.m.-9:00 p.m.) - must withstand a long shift.
Must be a registered voter in Maryland and at least 16 (parental permission if under 18).
Mandatory training class required; $50 training pay and $25 setup pay tied to Election Day service.
Reserve judges must report to staging at 5:15 a.m. and accept assignment or no pay.

steps: Confirm you are a Maryland registered voter able to work a 15-hour day.
Submit the Election Judge 2026 application to the Anne Arundel County Board of Elections.
Attend the mandatory training class (~3 hours).
Serve on Election Day 5:45 a.m.-9:00 p.m. (plus Monday-night setup); $250-$350 by role, up to $425 with training/setup.
